title: Learning support check-in
intro: Pick the answers that sound most like you. We will suggest support features you can turn on. You can change them any time in Settings.
disclaimer: This questionnaire is not a medical judgment, and it will not label you or decide whether you have any learning difficulty. It only helps you choose display and reading options that feel more comfortable. Your answers stay on your device and are never sent to teachers or your school. If you find schoolwork hard, talk to a teacher, a social worker, or your school's support teacher.

supports.easy_read: Easy read: short sentences, bold key points, and content shown in sections
supports.read_aloud: Read aloud: read aloud in the current language
supports.focus_tunnel: Focus tunnel: show one step at a time and hide the rest
supports.large_text: Large text: bigger font size and more line spacing
supports.reduce_motion: Reduce motion: turn off animation and flashing effects

questions.question: When you read a long piece of text, do you often lose your place or forget where you stopped?
Do you prefer to learn new things by listening or by reading?
When a screen is busy with lots of things, do you find it hard to focus?
Do the words on the screen feel too small, so you have to squint?
Do moving animations or flashing effects distract you or make you uncomfortable?
When you work on SBA or write art criticism, do you prefer to go step by step, or see the whole task at once?

result_text: Based on your answers, we suggest turning on the features below. You can turn any of them off any time if they do not suit you.
